prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write solution.rs with the public function at module scope; use only the standard library.
Required API: pub fn idempotency_batch_trace(keys: &[String], amounts: &[i32]) -> Option<Vec<i32>>
Behavior: Process aligned idempotency keys and signed amounts in arrival order. Apply only the first amount for each key and emit the cumulative total after every arrival. Reject unequal lengths or an empty key; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: keys [a,b,a,c] and amounts [5,2,99,-1] return [5,7,7,6].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: use std::collections::HashSet;pub fn idempotency_batch_trace(keys:&[String],amounts:&[i32])->Option<Vec<i32>>{if keys.len()!=amounts.len(){return None}let mut seen=HashSet::new();let mut out=Vec::new();let mut total=0;for(k,&a)in keys.iter().zip(amounts){if k.is_empty(){return None}if seen.insert(k){total+=a}out.push(total)}Some(out)}
